title: Probability of an index event
statement: Let $D$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $A$ be a property of lists of elements of $	ext{Fin}(D)$. The probability of $A$ under a uniformly chosen length-$k$ sequence from $	ext{Fin}(D)$ is the number of such sequences for which $A$ holds, divided by $D^k$.
hypotheses_covered: A property of lists with entries in $	ext{Fin}(D)$
